Simple, respectful illustration showing the rugged Jabal an-Nur (Mountain of Light) near Makkah at night, with a small glowing cave opening (Cave of Hira) near the peak. A crescent moon in the sky. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

Map of the Arabian Peninsula showing the Hijrah route from Makkah to Madinah (Yathrib). A dotted line starts at Makkah, moves south slightly to the Cave of Thawr, then traces a coastal, less-travelled route northwards along the Red Sea coast before turning inland to Quba and finally Madinah. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
